Hmm, what if I combine multiple fills? Like:

Together they'd fill the entire bottom half with purple!
But wait, that would also overwrite the top half... unless the fill only affects the bottom half when the block is in diamond orientation.
Let me just test this empirically. Let me go to diamond left, select purple, and press SPACE.
